text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...That was close. I was on the verge
of showing you an unladylike yawn—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies.
To be honest, lately my mind has been strangely active at night...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The moment I get into bed, my brain automatically starts scheduling my day...
And not just one, but multiple scenarios at that..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: When that happens, I can't stop wondering which choice is best... Ah... it's all starting to come back to me again—

Lately, it seems Eishin Flash
hasn't been getting much rest...
